torso_lift.value: fixed torso on balancing base (no lift column)

runtime_h.note: 6 h per charge, ~1 h recharge; contrary.com cites 4 h for earlier config

actuators.value: 1X Revo1 low-ratio motors with tendon-driven joints; back-drivable, no harmonic gears

end_effector.value: Robotiq 3-Finger Adaptive Gripper (visible in official imagery)

sensors_head.value: LED matrix face with two eye cameras; high-resolution panoramic cameras; mics/speakers

software_stack.value: proprietary; autonomous-by-default with shared autonomy / VR teleop fleet supervision (1 operator : fleet); EVE data trains 1X Redwood VLA and NEO

safety_compliance.value: soft organically-inspired mechanics, low-inertia tendon drives; no public ISO/UL certification found

availability.value: no longer marketed (page retired after NEO pivot); was B2B 'available now' via contact

notes: Status 'discontinued' = no longer sold/marketed after 1X's pivot to legged NEO; existing fleet remained in active deployment as of mid-2025, serving as data source for NEO's Redwood VLA. Two-wheel dynamically-balancing base (unusual among wheeled semi-humanoids).
